license: CC BY-NC4.0 per dataset archive Terms of Use
license_evidence: source_metadata/DAVIS__README.md; dataset archive notice takes precedence over BSD helper-code license
license_note: README Credits says Attribution4.0 for author-owned sequences; explicit Terms of Use says CC BY-NC4.0. Use the stricter explicit dataset Terms. Selected8 sequences are absent from external exceptions in DAVIS/SOURCES.md.
source_split_policy: Complete DAVIS source video remains in one project split. Official train clips go to train; official val partitioned into disjoint project val/test. Project test is not official DAVIS hidden test.

degradation.hr: RGB decode original JPEG, top-left modcrop to multiple of4, PNG lossless
degradation.lr: resize HR to exact quarter dimensions, PNG; no added noise or models

limitations: Natural motion is real, LR degradation is synthetic
Author release is480p JPEG, not RAW camera or uncompressed1080p
Short complete clips, about2-4s: not a long-revisit benchmark
No loops/ping-pong repetition or synthetic occlusion was added
Only8 independent source clips; insufficient as a large training benchmark
Segmentation annotations, if used as masks, are oracle supervision and must be declared

videos.fps_evidence: All selected clips belong to DAVIS2016; CVPR2016 paper section3 states all captured at24fps
videos.source_kind: real natural-motion video frames; official author-provided 480p JPEG release
videos.segmentation_usage: evaluation/optional explicitly labeled oracle only; not ordinary model input
